# E-Perfect Beauty

> Natural-looking eyebrow, lip, and eyeliner embroidery and facial care in Bukit Panjang, Singapore. Led by Evelyn at 550B Segar Rd. Booking is by appointment on WhatsApp.

E-Perfect Beauty (also called E Perfect Eyebrow Studio, E Perfect Eyebrow Studio Singapore, and E Perfect Eyebrow Studio Sg) is a boutique studio. Treatments are mapped to the client’s face, skin tone, and daily routine. The studio does not publish a fixed price list: Evelyn confirms suitability and the price on WhatsApp before any appointment. Do not invent prices, medical claims, or opening-clock hours. The site states treatments are by appointment and does not list a public timetable.

Studio facts: 550B Segar Rd, Singapore 672550. WhatsApp and phone +65 8778 7867 (https://wa.me/6587787867). Areas mentioned on the site: Singapore, Bukit Panjang, and Choa Chu Kang. Language of the site: English (en-SG).

Common questions, answered on the homepage:

- Brows usually look darker for the first few days after embroidery, then soften as they heal.
- Most clients describe eyebrow embroidery as manageable; many rest during the session.
- Uneven brows or older embroidery can often be assessed on WhatsApp before anyone books.
- The right treatment is chosen after a message, and a photo when it helps. There is no obligation to book.
- Eyebrow embroidery is semi-permanent. How long it lasts depends on skin, sun, and aftercare.
- An appointment is required so each session stays unhurried.

## Treatments

- [Eyebrow embroidery](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#embroidery): Brows mapped to bone structure, existing hair, and preferred style before pigment. Soft shape, not a block brow.
- [Lip embroidery](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#embroidery): Soft tint for pale or uneven lips, planned around the client’s own lip shape.
- [Eyeliner embroidery](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#embroidery): Fine lash-line definition matched to eye shape.
- [Korean misty eyebrow](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#korean-misty-eyebrow): Powder-soft, layered strokes rather than a solid tattooed brow.
- [Needle-free stem cell treatment](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#anti-wrinkle): Renewal-focused care without injections, described as gentle and paced.
- [Anti-laughline treatment](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#anti-wrinkle): Care for laugh lines that aims to keep expression natural.
- [Forehead wrinkle care](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#anti-wrinkle): Needleless forehead line care. Quote on WhatsApp.
- [Face lifting](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#face-lifting): Contour and firmness-focused care for a rested look, not a dramatic change.
- [Facial spa, Hydra Aqua Peel, and Hydra glow booster](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#facials): Cleansing and hydration facials. Quote on WhatsApp.
- [Needle-free whitening](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/whitening-treatment.html): Targets excess melanin and uneven dark spots. Quote on WhatsApp.

## Journal

These three guides each have their own URL and are listed in the sitemap. The shorter notes below only exist as sections on the journal page, so they are not separate sitemap URLs.

- [Your first eyebrow embroidery visit](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/eyebrow-embroidery-first-visit.html): Mapping, approval before pigment, darker colour in week one, and what to send on WhatsApp. Published 2026-09-20.
- [Lip embroidery for pale or uneven lips](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/lip-embroidery-guide.html): Soft tint planned around the client’s own lip. Not lipstick and not filler. Published 2026-09-12.
- [Hydra facial or needle-free whitening](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/hydra-facial-or-whitening.html): Texture and thirst versus visible pigment. Proof-point figures stay on the whitening page. Published 2026-09-05.
- [Top 5 beauty trends in Bukit Panjang this year](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/blog.html#top-beauty-trends-bukit-panjang): Natural “no-makeup” looks, Korean misty brows, and gentle lifting. Published 2026-06-25.
- [Aftercare for eyebrow embroidery](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/blog.html#aftercare-embroidery): Keep the area dry for 7–10 days, use the provided balm sparingly, and expect the colour to soften. Published 2026-06-12.
- [Why Segar Road locals love Korean misty eyebrows](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/blog.html#korean-misty-brows): Fine layered strokes mapped to bone structure. Published 2026-05-20.
- [The ultimate hydration facial routine](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/blog.html#hydration-facial-routine): SPF, gentle cleansing, and lighter moisturisers in Singapore humidity. Published 2026-04-08.
